action_items: Minor: /wealth/anchor response returned `mosaic_block: null` this run, so the UI renders 'Mosaic blok #—' instead of a number. Manifest SHA still shows correctly (fb3f8199aa5b…). Consider whether the backend should always return a monotonically increasing block index in the simulator or the UI should hide the '#—' placeholder. Not blocking.

Minor: expo bundler logs a compatibility hint 'expo@54.0.36 - expected version: ~54.0.37' and 'expo-constants@18.0.13 - expected version: ~18.0.14'. Non-breaking, but consider `npx expo install --check` before native builds.

Optional: request note said Video Legacy list should be empty for founder — it actually shows 1 seeded video ('Testovací odkaz'). Update the request assumption or clean seed if you want a true empty-state test.
critical_code_review_comments: All new screens use testID consistently on interactive elements — great for automation.

Wealth Vault correctly masks IBAN (SK31…7541 → SK31…7541 shows as masked in `iban_masked`) and crypto address (`address_masked`) and shows '🔐 seed zapečatený' badge — zero-knowledge intent preserved on UI.

Inner Circle handles founder vs non-founder gracefully via `founder_only` error string sniff — works but slightly brittle (recommend the backend return a structured 403 with a code the UI checks by status/code rather than message).
Video Legacy relies on `ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({ mediaTypes: ['videos'] })` — modern API, correct. Cannot be exercised on web preview (documented behavior).
Duress alarms list grows on every decoy verify — correct; UI localises timestamps via `sk-SK` locale.
No deprecated packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) referenced in the 7 new screens.
All text is wrapped in <Text>. All styles via StyleSheet.create(). No className / div usage. React Native compliance clean.
